increment_paragraph: **OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT** (round 42, USER DECISION 2026-11-27 "we need to audit for otel related modules. This can be validated with otel protocols"; [report](../../reports/otel-proto-audit/README.md); Phase A only, no verdict change). Pinned protocol identity: opentelemetry-proto 3a6e438 (v1.11.1-19-g3a6e438), 11 `.proto` sha256 digests in the census, refused on any difference by `scripts/otel_proto_audit.py identity --check`. Coverage: of the brief's OTel modules only the cmetrics and ctraces OTLP codecs are measured (5 units, 245 functions, corpus and twelve-home, identical rows): custody 51 Safe / 194 Unknown, null 120 / 120 / 5 Unsafe (provisional allocation findings in ctr_encode_opentelemetry.c), combined 38 / 202 / 5; Unknown reasons missing contract 171, unsupported construct 129, unresolved alias 118, null formal 71 and memory field 88; 795 functions (generated descriptors, protobuf-c runtime, src/opentelemetry, in_/out_opentelemetry, the envelope processor) are on no pinned route. Conformance: the compiled descriptors equal opentelemetry-proto v1.10.0 exactly; the pinned commit adds Span.type (field 17) and the ProcessContext message, which the vendored code lacks; a stale uncompiled pprofextended.pb-c.c (protoc-c 1.4.1) redefines eight message names; generated by protoc-c 1.5.2 against runtime 1.5.0. Obligations: 758 sites of O0-O5 (unpack result, sub-message, repeated bound, oneof case, bytes length, enum range) read from Clang's AST, 526 guarded with the guard cited, 0 candidates, 232 not determinable in six named classes; on the wire 307 guarded, 19 not determinable. Every obligation, premise, class and refusal is a formula of the new OTP block of the C04.18.9 typed rendering (35 terms, 5 sorts, appended after CX; 22 formulas checked by `guarded_proposition`; Lean `QCore.OtelProtoObligations`, one theorem per formula, standard axioms only). Phase B (a provider crate for the generated types recommended; at most 17 null rows and 1 combined row Unknown -> Safe on corpus and twelve-home) awaits the user's choice.

ledger.title: The OpenTelemetry protocol facts are stated and checked, but no contract carries them and no verdict rests on them
ledger.text: Card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT (round 42) stated protobuf-c's unpack facts and the six decoder/encoder obligations O0-O5 as formulas of the new OTP block (22 formulas, guarded_proposition, Lean QCore.OtelProtoObligations) and censused 758 sites in the OTel units (526 guarded, 0 candidates, 232 not determinable), but nothing reads them when deciding a verdict. Phase B options (report section 6): (1, recommended) a new provider crate quirin-provider-fluent-otel-proto on the shipped load path owning the generated *__unpack/__free_unpacked/__init/__pack functions with the WellFormed postcondition as result facts, a plugin-SDK checker as in quirin-provider-libcurl, its pin the protocol identity plus every compiled .pb-c.c/.pb-c.h and protobuf-c.c digest, consumers linking by linkage_contract_v1; (2) a plugin-SDK user crate (no shipped route can rest on it); (3) restating the facts in the cmetrics, ctraces and fluent-bit crates (four authorities). Either way the null model needs a conditional member reading (an element below a tested count, a sub-message under a tested presence, a member under a tested case), an analyzer change with Lean parity. Expected effect, an upper bound: system and slice none; corpus and twelve-home at most 17 null rows and 1 combined row (cmt_encode_opentelemetry_batch.c request_data_point_count) Unknown -> Safe. DISCHARGE: the user's choice, implemented and measured.

ledger.title: The vendored fluent-otel-proto code is opentelemetry-proto v1.10.0, not the pinned protocol commit
ledger.text: Card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT compared the compiled descriptors with every tag of the protocol clone: they equal v1.10.0 exactly (0 differences); the pinned commit 3a6e438 (v1.11.1-19-g3a6e438) differs by Span.type (field 17) and the ProcessContext message. A contract resting on the protocol must name which identity it rests on: the vendored descriptors (what the code decodes) or the pinned protocol. DISCHARGE: a recorded decision, applied in the Phase B pin (OTEL-PROTO-PHASE-B).

ledger.title: opentelemetry.proto.trace.v1.Span.type (field 17, string) is absent from the vendored generated code
ledger.text: Conformance difference D1 of card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT: the pinned protocol declares Span.type = 17 (implicit presence); the vendored trace.pb-c.c has no descriptor for it, so ctraces' decoder keeps it only as an unknown field and its encoder cannot emit it. A fact, not a defect claim; nothing is filed upstream. DISCHARGE: the vendored code regenerated at a protocol that has it (an upstream matter), or the Phase B basis decision recording it as not decodable.

ledger.title: opentelemetry.proto.processcontext.v1development.ProcessContext has no vendored generated code
ledger.text: Conformance difference D2 of card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT: process_context.proto (2 fields, added after v1.10.0) has no .pb-c.c counterpart; no Fluent Bit unit names the message. DISCHARGE: recorded as outside the decodable set in the Phase B basis decision, or generated code appears and is audited.

ledger.title: fluent-otel-proto ships a stale, uncompiled pprofextended.pb-c.c that redefines eight profiles message names
ledger.text: Conformance fact D3 of card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT: proto_c/opentelemetry/proto/profiles/v1development/pprofextended.pb-c.c was generated by protoc-c 1.4.1, is absent from the compile database, defines 8 message names profiles.pb-c.c also defines (Profile, Sample, Location, ...) and AttributeUnit, Label and AggregationTemporality, which no current tag declares. The conformance reader refuses a twice-generated name and excludes the file by name. A provider pin must exclude it too. DISCHARGE: the exclusion stated in the Phase B pin, or the file gone from the pinned tree.

ledger.title: 173 encoder sites rely on fields the encoder itself built; the site reader does not follow the construction
ledger.text: Not-determinable class N1 of card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT (reason encoder-constructed-value): in cmt_encode_opentelemetry.c, ctr_encode_opentelemetry.c, flb_opentelemetry_otlp_proto.c, out_opentelemetry and cprof_encode_opentelemetry.c, a dereference, subscript or oneof read of a message the encoder allocated and filled, often in another function, with no test on the path. Not reachable from wire input, so never a candidate. DISCHARGE: a construction-aware reading (the allocation-and-assignment that sets the field, across the unit's calls) classifies them guarded or candidate, re-running scripts/otel_proto_sites.py.

ledger.title: 17 OTel sites hand a protobuf field to a unit callee that passes it on further or too deep
ledger.text: Not-determinable class N2 of card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT (callee-passes-parameter-on 16 off the wire, callee-variadic-or-deep 1 on it: cprof_decode_opentelemetry.c:772): the callee's parameter is copied or handed to a further callee the reader does not follow past depth 3. DISCHARGE: the interprocedural reading extended (parameter copies, deeper chains), each site classified.

ledger.title: 15 encoder sites hand a repeated field's array to a callee without its count
ledger.text: Not-determinable class N3 of card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT (array-passed-without-its-count): the destroy_*_list helpers and memcpy copies of bucket_counts in the cmetrics, ctraces and cprofiles encoders and out_opentelemetry receive the array but not n_x, so the bound the callee relies on is not visible at the call. Off the wire. DISCHARGE: the callee's own bound (a NULL-terminated list, a separately passed length) read, each site classified.

ledger.title: 13 OTel sites hand a bytes field's data to a callee; correct only if the callee accepts data = NULL with len = 0
ledger.text: Not-determinable class N4 of card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT: 8 on the wire (ctr_span_set_trace_id/_span_id/_parent_span_id and ctr_link_create from ctr_decode_opentelemetry.c, cfl_variant_create_from_bytes from cmt_decode_opentelemetry.c:131, msgpack_pack_bin_with_body from in_opentelemetry/opentelemetry_logs.c:207, convert_bytes_value), 5 off it (memcmp in cprof_encode link_equal, memcpy in ctr_encode). protobuf-c leaves data NULL exactly when len is 0 (otp_bytes_data_iff_length). DISCHARGE: each callee's handling of (NULL, 0) read from its body (memcpy/memcmp with a NULL pointer and length 0 is undefined in C17), each site classified.

ledger.title: 11 OTel sites hand a sub-message or repeated array to a callee defined in another unit
ledger.text: Not-determinable class N5 of card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT (callee-outside-unit; 7 on the wire: cmt_decode_opentelemetry.c:1031 explicit_bounds, cprof_decode_opentelemetry.c :52, :96, :470 (2), :542 (2)): the site reader is intra-unit. DISCHARGE: the callees' bodies read across units (or declared), each site classified.

ledger.title: 3 decoded OpenTelemetry enum values are handed to callees in other units
ledger.text: Not-determinable class N6 of card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT (enum-to-callee-outside-unit, all on the wire): otel_span->kind to ctr_span_kind_set and otel_span->status->code to ctr_span_set_status (ctr_decode_opentelemetry.c:620, :625), severity_number to msgpack_pack_uint64 (in_opentelemetry/opentelemetry_logs.c:317). A decoder keeps any int32, named or not (otp_enum_index_needs_name). DISCHARGE: each callee read for an unnamed value (an index, a table lookup), each site classified.

ledger.title: 795 functions of the OpenTelemetry modules are on no pinned route
ledger.text: Coverage census of card OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT: only the cmetrics and ctraces OTLP codecs (5 units, 245 functions) are measured, on corpus and twelve-home; system and slice hold no OTel unit. Unmeasured: the generated descriptors (11 units, 348 functions), the protobuf-c runtime (90), fluent-otel-proto's helper (1), src/opentelemetry (219), in_opentelemetry (60), out_opentelemetry (70), processor_opentelemetry_envelope (7); adjacent, not named by the brief: cprofiles' OTLP codec (97) and processor_content_modifier's cm_opentelemetry.c (5). They are never counted as covered. DISCHARGE: a pinned route that measures them (a system-selection extension or a new selection), measured.

OBSERVED by OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT (round 42, pinned tree 66910c10): the oneof reads of the OpenTelemetry decoders are case-tested. Its site census (scripts/otel_proto_sites.py, O3) finds 198 oneof member reads on the brief's modules, 123 guarded by a switch or test on the case discriminant (value_case, data_case) and 75 in encoder-built messages, not determinable (guarded/not determinable: cmetrics 92/46, ctraces 16/11, in_opentelemetry 7/0, out_opentelemetry 8/9, src/opentelemetry 0/9); none is unguarded on the wire. Those guarded sites are the live-member reading this entry's discharge asks for (a tag test dominating the read), with the line of each test in docs/reports/otel-proto-audit/census.json.

OBSERVED by OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT: the pinned compile database (build/compile_commands.json, sha256 5e6868d9...f7e78, Fluent Bit 66910c10) compiles the root copies lib/cprofiles/cprof_*.c (19 units, among them cprof_decode_opentelemetry.c and cprof_encode_opentelemetry.c) and no file under lib/cprofiles/src/.
